description: Defines the PhpRequirements class for dynamically determining the minimum supported PHP version based on end-of-life dates and current date, used within Drupal core.

classes.name: PhpRequirements
classes.description: Provides methods to identify the minimum supported PHP version dynamically based on end-of-life dates and current date.

methods.name: getMinimumSupportedPhp
methods.description: Returns the minimum supported PHP version based on the current date or a provided date, considering end-of-life dates and Drupal's minimum PHP requirement.
